run_GTestFilterUnitTest: run the googletest filter unit test suite to verify test filtering and sharding behavior
test_SetEnvVar: test the SetEnvVar utility function that sets or unsets environment variables for subprocess tests
test_RunAndExtractTestList: test the RunAndExtractTestList function that runs a test binary and parses the list of tests executed
test_InvokeWithModifiedEnv: test the InvokeWithModifiedEnv utility that runs a function with temporary environment variable overrides
test_RunWithSharding: test the RunWithSharding function that runs a shard of tests using GTEST_TOTAL_SHARDS and GTEST_SHARD_INDEX
